pages.text: $(l)HUD$(): body silhouette (part colour shows its state), overall condition bar, sensations as text, treatment progress.

$(l)H$() — examination panel: your own or the one you look at. It shows body parts, wounds, what is applied, and your medical items — drag them straight onto a body part.$(br2)$(l)K$() — how you feel from nutrition.$(br)$(l)G$() (hold) — finish off a downed player.

Move HUD elements with $(l)/rpmedicine hud$().$(br2)Client settings (screen effects, sounds, volume, "no minigames") — Esc → Mods → RP Medicine → Config.$(br2)Looking at a patient with a medical item in hand shows a short summary: bleeding, conscious or not.
